import json, subprocess, sys
def run(doc):

                       input=json.dumps(doc).encode(), stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    return json.loads(p.stdout), p.stderr

    "length_embedding": [[a] for a in range(16)], "gap_embedding": [[0] for _ in range(16)],
    "kernel": 1, "conv_weights": [[[1, 0]]], "conv_bias": [0], "conv_shift": [0],
    "dense_weights": [[64], [-64]], "dense_bias": [0, 64]}

def cfg(**kw):
    c = {"slots": 1, "window": 1, "idle_timeout": 5, "len_quantum": 1, "gap_quantum": 1,
         "rate_num": 1, "rate_den": 1, "bucket_capacity": 8, "initial_tokens": 8,
         "pending_capacity": 8, "lanes": 2, "service": [100, 1], "fallback": 0,
         "time_edges": [0], "count_edges": [0], "probability": [[65536]]}
    c.update(kw); return c

# scenario D2: superseded feedback

        "model": BASE_MODEL,
        "connections": [{"id": "a", "slot": 0, "label": 1, "split": "eval"}],

                    {"time": 1, "connection": "a", "length": 0, "draw": 0},
                    {"time": 2, "connection": "a", "length": 0, "draw": 0},
                    {"time": 100, "connection": "a", "length": 0, "draw": 0}]}
